title: GeekWire (Todd Bishop) — 'Lean Startup' author reveals one regret about his bestselling book — and how his new one fixes it
summary: GeekWire's Todd Bishop covers Eric's Seattle Flow Startup Day keynote with a major news hook: Eric tells the room he wishes he had added three words — 'for the better' — to The Lean Startup's opening claim about changing the world, and that Incorruptible is the corrective. Article carries four pieces of Eric's structural advice for founders: file as a PBC immediately, do it now, treat mission as the number one source of competitive advantage, and define who you would never want to betray.
blockquote: Ries uses the word corruption not to mean fraud or bribery, but structural decay — the gradual corrosion that pulls thriving companies away from their missions.
